title: Web Nostr DNS control-plane client and run tracker

criteria.statement: Web code exposes DNS request/status/result constants and can publish zone create, policy apply, record override, and drift remediate as signed Nostr events.
DNS command runs track publish OK, request event id, status events, result payloads, rejected publish, and CLOSED/AUTH subscription errors.
Completion comes from explicit DNS result events and no REST write API is introduced in the DNS command path.
